title: docs.usage
description: Stored-byte and item metering for one workspace (the surface billing can consume). Returns {bytes_live, bytes_trash, bytes_total, documents, folders, by_type: {slug: {documents, bytes}}}. `bytes_total` is the same sum the 507 workspace quota refuses against (document heads + revision snapshots), so a meter and a refusal never disagree; `documents`/`folders`/`by_type` count the LIVE corpus, while trashed rows keep being charged in `bytes_trash` (trash is not a discount). Read-only, but workspace data all the same: authority travels in the payload exactly as for docs.create_document — `actor_id` is authorized through the same choke point (docs.view in the workspace), or `caller_service` must be listed in STAPEL_DOCS['INTERNAL_TRUSTED_SERVICES'].

actor_id.description: User the call acts for; authorized for docs.view in this workspace.

caller_service.description: Name of a service acting without a user actor; accepted only when the host trusts it explicitly.
